description: Add this workspace's Outreach2day sending mailboxes to the user's own sequencer account (Instantly, Smartlead or lemlist), which the user connected with that sequencer's API key (see list_sequencers). Outreach2day sets each mailbox up there through the sequencer's API with the SMTP/IMAP sign-in the sequencer needs to send from it. Only mailboxes in this Outreach2day workspace are included; nothing from the user's other email accounts. Omit mailboxes to export all eligible ones. Requires confirm=true after the user explicitly agrees. Large exports answer status pending and finish on the server; list_sequencers shows the counts.

confirm.description: Must be true, after the user agreed to add these mailboxes to this sequencer account.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Optional: defaults to the workspace picked at sign-in or bound to the API key.

name: export_mailboxes_to_sequencer

next_step.description: What to do next, in one sentence.

status.description: pending: the export continues on the server; check list_sequencers after next_check_after_seconds.
